sector_model: asset manager (nonfinancial treatment of fee income): AUM, fee rate, flows, operating margin, FCF after SBC, convertible leverage; not a bank or insurer
thesis: WisdomTree (NYSE: WT) is an ETF and ETP sponsor (gold, crypto, equity income, tokenized funds) that also bought Ceres Partners and, on 2026-05-01, Atlantic House (209.1M cash). Q3 2026 (10-Q read): revenue 179.4M (+42.8%), 9M revenue 516.0M (+49%, partly acquired), 9M operating income 205.3M (vs 114.4M), 9M net income 70.4M (vs 69.1M) after a 68.9M loss on convertible note repurchases; US listed ETF AUM 101.6B, European ETP AUM 66.0B, onchain 1.27B. TTM revenue 663.4M, operating income 265.0M, net income 110.4M, OCF 207.8M, FCF 203.9M, SBC 28.7M so FCF after SBC 175.2M. At the 2026-11-10 close of 20.77 and 150.9M shares, market cap 3.13B: 28.4x TTM GAAP net income, FCF yield 6.5% (5.6% after SBC). Convertible principal 1,078.75M against cash 299.7M; EV about 3.87B or 14.6x TTM operating income. Market may price WT as a crypto and gold flow sensitive manager with growing leverage; the evidence is growth in fee revenue and operating income, but earnings per share has not kept pace.
counterthesis: Revenue growth is largely acquired and tied to gold, crypto and fee rate mix, so a commodity or crypto drawdown reduces AUM and revenue together. Net debt is about 0.78B (convertibles 1,078.75M less cash 299.7M) versus TTM operating income 265M, and interest on the convertibles is about 52M a year; 9M net income barely rose (+1.8%) because of a 68.9M repurchase loss and higher interest and tax (35% rate). The 2030 notes (conversion 19.15) are in the money, so equity dilution of about 25M shares (about 16%) is likely if the price holds, and the capped call or hedge terms are unread. Part of reported fees arrive as gold and crypto (69.1M non-cash in 9M), so OCF understates and cash conversion depends on selling those assets. Goodwill and intangibles are 1.18B against equity 446M. Related party receivables are 60.5M. Single stock price fell about 5% around 11-05 and 11-03 volume was 7.4M, showing sentiment sensitivity.
invalidation: Net outflows or AUM decline in the next quarterly update, revenue growth excluding acquisitions below about 10%, operating margin under about 35%, convertible dilution beyond the 2030 and 2031 note share counts, further repurchase losses without cash benefit, a gold or crypto price break that cuts AUM sharply, or goodwill impairment.
